summary: KULR Technology Group disclosed in an 8-K the open-market disposition of its entire bitcoin treasury, selling roughly 764 BTC between August 20 and September 11, 2026 at a weighted average price near $76,633 per coin, generating about $58.6 million gross proceeds to unrelated purchasers. The company now holds no BTC. Separately, the compensation committee granted CFO Michael Kimel 200,000 time-based RSUs effective September 10, 2026, vesting in eight semi-annual installments beginning December 6, 2026. No advisor, premium, or regulatory clock is stated; watch how proceeds are redeployed and any related liquidity or impairment signal.
